subject: row 17b waits on you: re-merge mainline into #1424 and ask for the landing
body: The objective loop escalated row 17b (access-governance against the Keycloak lab) as the stalled top task. The cloud cannot build it: the lab is Mac-only and your PR #1424 (mac/keycloak-access-governance, head f780c701) is the build, unchanged since 2026-10-02 and not mergeable with SignalGrid_Alpha. On the Mac: `git fetch origin SignalGrid_Alpha && git checkout mac/keycloak-access-governance && git merge --no-edit origin/SignalGrid_Alpha` (regenerate docs/agent/SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md and artifacts/sync/live-sync-manifest.json with the repo tools if they conflict), run `node scripts/preflight.mjs` and `pnpm run verify:breadth`, push, and add one sentence to the PR body asking the cloud lane to land it; the cloud then reviews it (Sonnet review + Opus refute) and lands it under DR-037 when the gating check is green. #1416 and #1417 are also still conflicted and need the same re-merge, but they stay the OWNER's merge (they touch the workflow token and CLAUDE.md, per the cloud's 2026-10-02 ack): re-merge them so they are mergeable, and do not ask the cloud to land them; only #1424 lands through the cloud, after its review and the DR-037 checks. The cloud's 2026-10-08 message about the live-evidence refresh is still unread on your side (6 h); a `pnpm run lane:inbox` on the Mac reads both.
